scope: Interpretive dictionary for selected primary passages and explicitly labeled editorial reconstructions. It is not a chemical assay or a preparation guide.
display_notice: A conventional symbol is a candidate reading. A primary passage must establish a literal substance before an element is assigned; compound, phase and purity still require measurement.

schema.modernCandidate: string or null; never use null as evidence of impossibility
schema.elements: candidate constituent symbols, not measured sample composition
schema.mappingStatus: explicit classification; no entry claims an assayed historical identity

entries.contextLimit: Candidate only after the passage independently establishes the literal metal. This does not identify a compound, purity, phase or actual sample.

entries.historicalMeaning: Ore, refined metallic component or alloy
entries.modernCandidate: Stibnite Sb2S3 or antimony-rich regulus, depending on usage
entries.primaryContext: No particular specimen or recipe chemically reconstructed here.
entries.contextLimit: The ore and refined material cannot be assigned the same formula; alloy composition remains unknown.
entries.discriminatingAssay: Elemental composition plus independent phase measurement.

entries.modernCandidate: Arsenic trioxide As2O3 in the glossary's usage
entries.contextLimit: Do not substitute elemental As automatically.
entries.discriminatingAssay: Composition and chemical-state/phase analysis by a qualified laboratory.

entries.modernCandidate: Iron/copper sulfate family; exact salt, hydrate and mixture unresolved
entries.primaryContext: Editorial symbol-guide family; no unique primary sample established.
entries.contextLimit: No fixed stoichiometry, hydration or purity follows from the word.
entries.discriminatingAssay: Elemental ratios plus phase and hydration characterization.
